import re

# Define patterns that indicate an incorrect order
incorrect_order_patterns = [
    r'\bwrong order\b',
    r'\bincorrect order\b',
    r'\border.{0,20}wrong\b',
    r'\border.{0,20}incorrect\b',
    r'\bgot.{0,20}wrong\b',
    r'\bgave.{0,20}wrong\b',
    r'\bmessed up.{0,20}order\b',
    r'\border.{0,20}messed up\b',
    r'\bwrong.{0,20}item\b',
    r'\bwrong.{0,20}food\b',
    r'\bnot what (I|we) ordered\b',
    r'\bdidn\'t get what (I|we) ordered\b',
    r'\border was.{0,5}(completely )?wrong\b',
    r'\bwrong.{0,20}order\b',
    r'\bmix(ed)? up.{0,15}order\b',
    r'\border.{0,15}mix(ed)? up\b',
    r'\border.{0,15}screwed up\b',
    r'\bscrewed up.{0,15}order\b',
    r'\bwrong bag\b',
    r'\bwrong drink\b',
    r'\bwrong sandwich\b',
    r'\bwrong burger\b',
    r'\bgave me.{0,20}(someone else|another)',
    r'\bincorrect\b',
]

# Count reviews with incorrect order mentions per location
from collections import defaultdict

location_incorrect_reviews = defaultdict(list)

for review in dataset:
    text_lower = review['text'].lower()
    for pattern in incorrect_order_patterns:
        if re.search(pattern, text_lower):
            location_incorrect_reviews[review['business_id']].append(review['review_id'])
            break  # Count each review only once

# Summary
print(f"Total locations: {len(business_ids)}")
print(f"Locations with at least 1 incorrect order review: {sum(1 for v in location_incorrect_reviews.values() if len(v) >= 1)}")
print(f"Locations with 2+ incorrect order reviews: {sum(1 for v in location_incorrect_reviews.values() if len(v) >= 2)}")
print(f"Locations with 3+ incorrect order reviews: {sum(1 for v in location_incorrect_reviews.values() if len(v) >= 3)}")
print()

# Show distribution
for bid, reviews in sorted(location_incorrect_reviews.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1])):
    print(f"  {bid}: {len(reviews)} incorrect order reviews")
